answer.summary: Verify the presence of explicitly reported state update mechanisms in Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1 under known perturbations.
answer.content: This investigation confirms whether Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1 contains direct, linguistic evidence of per-token update rules, conditional state transitions, or update frequencies in response to perturbations. If such mechanisms are absent, a bounded research question is proposed on the minimum duration of periodic input required for observable memory persistence, strictly derived from explicitly stated update rules in the source text. No external assumptions or inferences are permitted beyond what is directly reported in the section's text.

answer.lesson: All memory research must first establish explicit, numerically defined, and time-bound retention or update rules in primary sources before any downstream analysis or hypothesis generation can proceed; absence of such data mandates a bounded, source-anchored research question without speculative extension.'
